Class Entity

java.lang.Object
Entity
Direct Known Subclasses:
Commander, Engineer, MaintenanceBot, PowerCell

The parent class for all entity types.

    • worldTimeStep

      public static void worldTimeStep()
      Advances the simulation by one time step. The order of operations within a single time step is: 1. Each existing entity performs its action for this step 2. Resolve encounters — when multiple entities share a location 3. Deduct rest energy cost and remove dead entities 4. Add any offspring born this step to the world 5. Reset movement tracking for the next step 6. Spawn new PowerCells (Params.refresh_powercell_count per step)
